summary.text: Cynthia Neeley is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 70 who has represented the district since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Flint resident and business owner, she serves on the Financial Services, Health Policy and Regulatory Reform committees.

paragraphs.text: Neeley lives in Flint, Michigan, graduated from Star City High School, and owned a business before entering the legislature.
In the 2023-2024 session she chaired the House Tax Policy Committee, which has since been decommissioned.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Larry Hutchinson in the general election on November 3, 2026.
